name: Fuckass Funzone · Arcade Intermission
author: KittyLotus
description: Frontend-only Funzone OS arcade: Bird, Jetpack, Snake, 2048, Match-3, Plinko, Simon, Duck Hunt, fictional-ticket Slots, Tetris, Solitaire, Froggy, Catmate Chess, Berry Drop, Tic Tac Treats, Cake Tower, Bubble Bloom, Boop-a-Bun, Wobbly Wafers, Gacha Match and Gabu's Gambit. Custom art, saves and generation-aware HUD. Gambit is an original poker roguelike with 75 Jokers, eight boosters, deck crafting, an eight-Ante campaign and Endless play.
